answer: Make every identity pay a real cost before it can earn: an agent must lock a small bond in a shared vault and complete verifiable work that takes genuine compute, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds. Peers then forge a reputation score from attested contributions over time, and only agents with a proven record unlock the best rewards. The network becomes an oasis for honest workers, while sybils find the entry price higher than anything they could steal.
